summary: Convert dimensionless k c/omega_pi and propagation angle into SI perpendicular and parallel coordinates.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: k=kj/cwp, kx=k sin(theta), kz=k cos(theta); cwp=c/omega_pi uses explicit source reference species, theta in degrees.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: kj
inputs.description: Signed normalized radial wavevector parameter k*c/omega_pi; negative values are retained.
inputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

inputs.name: theta_degrees
inputs.description: Propagation angle from the magnetic-field axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

outputs.name: kx
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

outputs.name: kz
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

outputs.name: k
outputs.description: Signed radial parameter kj/cwp; not the nonnegative norm of the returned components.
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

outputs.name: theta
outputs.description: Input theta_degrees converted to radians without wrapping.
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
supported: Finite scan values and positive finite reference length.
excluded: No implicit alternate reference species or radians.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for nonfinite/unrepresentable real scalars or cwp<=0.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Python/dependency errors propagate; this operator launches no native process and has no native execution receipt.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.
